page.overview:
Who is Arstanosaurus?

(meaning "Arstan lizard" after the Arstan well) is a genus of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/hadrosaurid hadrosauroid] dinosaur from the Santonian-Campanian-age Upper Cretaceous Bostobe Formation, Kazakhstan. It has had a confusing history, being considered both a hadrosaurid and a ceratopsid, or both at the same time (chimeric).
